title: Combinatorial niche spider
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for combinatorial multi-domain niche-cell forging, page-cursor coverage ledgers, persistent BFS spider frontiers, purposeful refresh for movers and 404 rot, bounded multi-wave follow-up proposals and 8-axis candidate evaluation with query-family yield benchmarks.
boundaries: Follow-up wave verbs and spider sweeps remain inert TaskSpec proposals for Tessera queues; the pack never creates an independent scheduler or auto-activates cron jobs.
Curated repository admission into reusable Seed Packs requires an independent reviewer whose worker_id and key_id both differ from the curator.
Standard-library code executes offline against deterministic fixtures without unauthenticated rate-limit abuse or live API calls.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for combinatorial niche forging, BFS spidering, refresh tracking and 8-axis evaluation

value.lets_workers: Cross domain facets with intents, angles, technology stacks, industry verticals and cross-domain hybrids into page-tracked search cells, expand qualifying discoveries breadth-first across authors, forks and outbound README links up to progressive depth caps, re-verify older entries to detect star-surge movers and 404 gone rot, score candidates on 8 separate 0-100 axes with negative-term false-positive guards, retire noisy <5 percent yield wave families and gate curated admissions through an independent reviewer.

flow.when: Mint combinatorial search cells across facets, intents, angles, stacks, verticals, cross-domain hybrids and custom phrases with rotating license, radar, star-band and in-readme paths.
Advance uncovered cell page cursors, traverse BFS spider edges, refresh longest-unchecked entries for movers and 404 rot, and emit bounded Wave 1-3 follow-up verb proposals.
Score candidates on 8 separate 0-100 axes, benchmark query-family yield, retire noisy wave tracks and independently review open-license admissions.

value.worked_example: Made-up 5-domain bundle (OCR+AI, Blender/3D, privacy tools, Three.js/WebGPU and 2 custom phrases) recomputed in test_niche_spider.py: mints 133 combinatorial cells, advances page cursor 1->2, unlocks spider depth 4 at run 16, enqueues 2 outbound edges and 2 bounded wave proposals while filtering generic topic 'react', rejects a 1,900-star low-level-design interview false positive, detects 1 star-surge mover and 1 HTTP 404 gone repo, retires a 2.5 percent yield broad_wave family, blocks self-approval (409) and admits MIT-licensed clinic-tools/intake-ocr-workbench under independent review.

nouns.title: Guardrail: spider waves emit inert TaskSpec proposals rather than running an independent scheduler
nouns.category_reason: Preserves Tessera as the single task and schedule authority.

value.rule: Harvested facets and spider frontier expansions emit bounded follow-up verb proposals with auto_enqueued=False; activating a recurring sweep requires an explicit authorized schedule on Tessera.
value.how_it_is_checked: advance_spider_frontier_and_waves sets auto_enqueued=False on every proposed wave verb and performs zero network calls.

nouns.title: Guardrail: block off-topic interview-prep collisions and auto-retire query families below 5 percent yield
nouns.category_reason: Prevents broad wave expansion from polluting domain leaderboards with generic software or interview prep repos.

value.rule: Search queries attach negative guards (-interview -leetcode -homework), generic topics (react, typescript, alibaba, interview) are excluded from wave spawning, and query families with >= 10 hits and < 5 percent on-topic yield are retired.
value.how_it_is_checked: score_candidate_axes zeros composite score on false-positive phrases and benchmark_query_families flags retired_for_noise.

nouns.title: Guardrail: curated repository admission into reusable Seed Packs requires a distinct reviewer
nouns.category_reason: Prevents single-agent hallucination or license-blind promotion.

value.rule: Both reviewer_worker_id and reviewer_key_id must differ from the curator, and admitted candidates must pass on_topic, freeness >= 85 and usefulness >= 65.
value.how_it_is_checked: verify_curated_admission_independently returns status_code 409 when worker or key IDs collide.

nouns.title: Specification: 8-axis 0-100 repository evaluation, BFS spider depth progression and query-family yield thresholds
nouns.category_reason: Defines transparent multi-axis evaluation rather than one opaque blended score.

nouns.title: Deterministic page-cursor advancement, anti-stall synonym mutation and rotating 8-path domain sweep rule
nouns.category_reason: Zero-model procedure ensuring every sweep covers fresh ground while re-verifying aging entries.

nouns.title: Tool card: standard-library combinatorial niche forge, BFS spider simulator and 8-axis evaluator
nouns.category_reason: Tested Python 3.10+ standard-library package pinned by path and SHA-256.

value.name: combinatorial niche spider
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Mints combinatorial search cells across facets, intents, angles, stacks, 16 industry verticals, platforms, cross-domain hybrids and injected phrases.
Tracks per-cell page cursors (1..5), advances a depth-capped BFS spider frontier (depth 2..8), proposes bounded Wave 1-3 follow-up verbs and triggers synonym mutations on zero-find stalls.
Re-verifies longest-unchecked entries to surface star-surge movers and HTTP 404 gone rot.
Scores candidates on 8 separate 0-100 axes, benchmarks query-family yield and enforces distinct-reviewer admission.
does_not: Call live GitHub APIs during import/build, bypass API rate limits, activate cron jobs on its own or self-approve admissions.
